description: Reliance Insurance Company Limited is a Pakistani general insurer incorporated as a public limited company in 1981 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It has written general insurance since 1981 and operates a nationwide network of 24 stations in the major cities, with its registered and head offices in Karachi.
